decisions: Measured the exact reproducible v1.0.5 wheel in 10 fresh-process or PTY samples after 2 warmups; every unchanged product threshold passed.
Keystroke rendering remained below the 50 ms threshold without weakening the gate.
result: Exact-wheel p95: version 25.011 ms, help 26.649 ms, 80x24 PTY prompt-ready 1031.298 ms, keystroke render 2.182 ms, offline doctor 3026.953 ms; every threshold passed.
limitations: Reference observation is macOS ARM64; exact-commit CI independently repeated the performance contract on Ubuntu.
